properties.notes: This site is allocated in the Crowhurst Neighbourhood Plan (adopted July 2019) for 6 dwellings and it should provide affordable housing in accordance with the relevant policies. The development shall have regard to the High Weald AONB and it should be supported by a tree survey; it shall comprise 1 or 2 bedroom units in the form of flats or apartments, any building should be of a traditional architectural vernacular and shall not exceed 2 storeys; access and parking shall be safe and adequate for both current residents and future occupiers. See Policy CH3 of the Crowhurst Neighbourhood Plan (http://www.rother.gov.uk/CHttpHandler.ashx?id=31999&p=0). December 2020 - No change
